PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose
s to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Beeranakere Village of Shivamogga
Taluk of Shivamogga District and to constitute a new revenue villages called
Beeranakere Tanda as specified in schedule.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in Schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of of
Beeranakere village for conversion of Beeranakere Tanda unrecorded habitation in
to hamlet/part of the said revenue village.

Now , therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said
Act, notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to
be affected thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or

after thirty days from the date of publication of the notification in the official
Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state

date Specified above will be considered by the state Government.
Objection or suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy
Commissioner, Shivamogga District.

SCHEDULE
Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column(3) of the
table shall be declared ashabitation area of Beeranakere Tanda village of
Shivamogga Taluk of Shivamogga District convert the same to form hamlet within
the boundary of Beeranakere Revenue village and same will herein after be named as
called Beeranakere Tanda of Beeranakere village in Shivamogga Taluk of
Shivamogga District.

Date: 30-06-2025

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka
proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Maluru Village of
Channapatna Taluk, Ramanagara District and to constitute a new revenue
villages called Byrapatna as specified in schedule along with maps with old
survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or

suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Ramanagara
District.

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Maluru of Channapatna Taluk Ramanagara District to form a new revenue
village called as Byrapatna of Channapatna Taluk Ramanagara District along
with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose
s to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Kolliganahalli Village of Harohalli
Taluk of Ramanagara District and to constitute a new revenue villages called
Siddayanadoddi as specified in schedule.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in Schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of of
Kolliganahalli village for conversion of Siddayanadoddi unrecorded habitation in to
hamlet/part of the said revenue village.

Now , therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said
Act, notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to
be affected thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or
after thirty days from the date of publication of the notification in the official
Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the
date Specified above will be considered by the state Government.
Objection or suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy
Commissioner, Ramanagara District.
SCHEDULE
Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column(3) of the
table shall be declared ashabitation area of Siddayanadoddi village of Harohalli
Taluk of Ramanagara District convert the same to form hamlet within the boundary
of Kolliganahalli Revenue village and same will herein after be named as called
Siddayanadoddi of Kolliganahalli village in Harohalli Taluk of Ramanagara
District.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka
proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Hosahalli Village of
Krishnarajanagara Taluk, Mysore District and to constitute a new revenue
villages called Crishchiyan Koppalu as specified in schedule along with maps
with old survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date

Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Mysore District.

specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Hosahalli of Krishnarajanagara Taluk Mysore District to form a new
revenue village called as Crishchiyan Koppalu of Krishnarajanagara Taluk
Mysore District along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA

RC-CFS/67/2025-RC Karnataka Government Secretariat
E- 1787579 Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, 560001
Date:30-06-2025

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose
s to issue a Notification to alter the limits of T.B.Kavalu Village of Kadur Taluk
of Chikkamagaluru District and to constitute a new revenue villages called
Niragundi Thanda as specified in schedule.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in Schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of of
T.B.Kavalu village for conversion of Niragundi Thanda unrecorded habitation in to
hamlet/part of the said revenue village.

Now , therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said
Act, notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to
be affected thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or
after thirty days from the date of publication of the notification in the official
Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the
date Specified above will be considered by the state Government.

Objection or suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy
Commissioner, Chikkamagaluru District.
SCHEDULE
Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column(3) of the
table shall be declared ashabitation area of Niragundi Thanda village of Kadur
Taluk of Chikkamagaluru District convert the same to form hamlet within the
boundary of T.B.Kavalu Revenue village and same will herein after be named as
called Niragundi Thanda of T.B.Kavalu village in Kadur Taluk of
Chikkamagaluru District.
